newsitem.title: UK: London platinum fixes at near three-year low.
newsitem.headline: London platinum fixes at near three-year low.

text.p: Platinum was fixed at $379.00 an ounce on Tuesday morning, the lowest fixing since December 10, 1993.
The metal had previously fixed at $381.75 an ounce on Monday afternoon. Platinum prices have been trending lower in recent months due to slack demand and ample supplies.
London platinum fixes at near three-year low
"There's been good turnover in the market," one dealer said.
The rest of the precious metals complex was also trending lower, with gold and silver trading at 20-month lows amid overwhelmingly bearish market sentiment.
Platinum's sister metal palladium fixed near recent lows at $115.75 an ounce, compared with $117.25 on Monday afternoon.
Platinum is produced primarily in South Africa and Russia, and used chiefly by automakers for catalytic converters and in the jewellery industry.
